testcase.name: Scenario: Group search criteria for the same feature property: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:382:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Group search criteria for the same feature property ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part with one extrusion and no fillet is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Find dialog contains the criterion Type equals Extrusion ✔ And Features is the selected object type and And is selected for additional criteria ✔ When the user chooses Type equals Fillet and clicks Add to list ✔ Then a prompt says criteria using the same property must be grouped ✔ And the prompt offers to add the criterion using the OR operator ✔ When the user chooses Yes ✔ Then the criteria list shows Type equals Extrusion ✔ And the next line shows OR Type equals Fillet ✔ When the user closes and reopens the Find dialog ✔ Then both criteria remain in the list ✔ When the user clicks Find Now ✔ Then the extrusion row is selected and the block edges are highlighted ✔ And the Find dialog remains open ✔ When the user closes the Find dialog and clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the highlight disappears and the part remains visible
